blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: backtracking — Explore choices and undo a failed path.
search tree — Branches of possible decisions.
base case — Condition ending a recursive branch.

blocks.title: Make a decision
blocks.text: At each position choose the current item or skip it. Track index and running total.

blocks.title: Reject a dead end
blocks.text: When the sum exceeds the target (non-negative inputs) or the list ends, undo the choice.

blocks.title: Backtrack
blocks.text: Try the other branch; success means a valid selection has been found. Exponential worst-case growth remains possible.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: The first path over-shoots: 2+3+4=9, so reject that branch.
